purpose: Section 29: honest, precise disclosure of every diagnosed-but-not-remediated defect this phase found, so a future iteration (or a product decision not to iterate) starts from evidence rather than rediscovery.

risks.status: DIAGNOSED, DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED (unchanged from disclosure in 04-article-x-independent-adjudication.json and 05-generalized-remediation-record.json)
risks.mechanism: signals.ts's EXERCISE_REMEDIES ACTION_PATTERNS regex (/\b(event of default|remedies|acceleration)\b/i) fires on any bare mention of 'remedies' or 'acceleration', regardless of whether the text asserts an action of exercising remedies. This causes the Article X guaranty/reinstatement cluster (doc-a::X::10.01a-us-guaranty, 10.04-defenses-waived, 10.06-reinstatement) to spuriously share an action tag with unrelated subordination/senior-indebtedness-designation candidates.
risks.confirmedByThisRerun: All 3 cluster cases were independently re-flagged as false credits by the fresh second-pass reviewer in this rerun (see 11-detailed-confusion-matrix.json's allFourV2CreditedCasesAndReviewerDisposition), corroborating the Section 11 adjudication (B_REVIEWER_CORRECT) with a completely independent reviewer instance.
risks.whyStillNotFixed: Same reasoning as the original disclosure: this regex is shared across the entire deterministic pipeline for every dataset; a change here has broad, hard-to-fully-bound blast radius, and responsibly validating it cross-dataset was outside this phase's remaining effort budget once the 85% detailed-agreement gate was already shown to fail for other reasons (R3 below) - fixing R1 alone would not have closed that gap.

risks.status: DIAGNOSED, DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED (new finding this phase, surfaced while authoring the SS10 adversarial test case)
risks.mechanism: The same class of defect as R1: ACTION_PATTERNS' acquisition regex (/\b(permitted\s+)?acquisition(s)?\b/i -> ACQUIRE_BUSINESS) fires on the bare word 'acquisition' regardless of legal context. A Change-of-Control definition describing 'the acquisition by any Person...of beneficial ownership' (an equity-ownership-acquisition, unrelated to the M&A covenant sense of acquiring a business) gets spuriously tagged ACQUIRE_BUSINESS purely from the word choice.
risks.confirmedByThisRerun: Not directly observed in the 51-case sample's disagreements (no case in this sample's disagreement set involves this specific regex), but confirmed by direct code inspection and reproduced in the SS10 test case's first iteration (fixed at the test-fixture level, not the evaluator level - see 06-new-adversarial-tests.json's iterationLog).
risks.whyNotFixed: Same blast-radius/effort-budget reasoning as R1 - both are instances of a broader, generalized pattern (keyword-only ACTION_PATTERNS regexes with no legal-context discrimination) that would need a single, carefully-validated redesign rather than two independent patches.

risks.status: NEWLY DIAGNOSED THIS PHASE - the dominant driver of the failed 85% detailed-agreement gate
risks.mechanism: When a candidate addresses a DIFFERENT specific sub-provision within the SAME covenant section as the GT claim (e.g., GT claim is Section 6.02(h)'s customs/bankers'-acceptance Lien carve-out; candidate is Section 6.02(d)'s pre-existing-Lien carve-out), the two share substantial common vocabulary (the parent covenant's own terms: 'Lien', 'Section 6.02', 'Indebtedness', etc.) purely because they are siblings under the same covenant family - this is enough for C_OBJECT_RESOURCE to resolve CORRESPONDS even at this phase's raised SOLE_DIMENSION threshold, because the shared vocabulary is genuine substantive legal language, not thin boilerplate. H_PROVISION_ROLE_BREADTH (the dimension designed to make 'chapeau credited via unrelated descendant' structurally impossible) does NOT catch this pattern because it classifies DRAFTING SHAPE (chapeau vs. specific-exception vs. affirmative-obligation), not SUBJECT IDENTITY among same-shape siblings - two different lettered exceptions under the same chapeau have the SAME shape classification. The dimensions that WOULD distinguish the two specific sub-provisions (E_ECONOMICS, F_CONDITIONS_EXCEPTIONS) typically resolve MISSING_REQUIRED_DIMENSION (silent) rather than MATERIAL_CONFLICT on both sides, because the wrong sibling candidate does not affirmatively CONTRADICT the claim's specific figures - it simply never mentions them. The pair therefore resolves deterministically to CORRESPONDS_PARTIALLY (a terminal deterministic outcome), and evaluatePair() (semantic-correspondence.ts) only ever consults the live semantic judge when the deterministic correspondence is INDETERMINATE - never when it is CORRESPONDS_PARTIALLY. A confidently-wrong deterministic classification is therefore never second-guessed by the live judge, no matter how available and authorized it is.
risks.confirmedByThisRerun: The repeat-offender candidates identified in 11-detailed-confusion-matrix.json (coverage-unit:0b33f42d... causing false matches against BOTH doc-a::III::3.03-no-conflicts and doc-a::VI::6.02h; ir-rule:263e0f01... causing false matches against BOTH doc-a::VI::6.05b and 6.08b-chapeau) are direct, concrete instances of this exact mechanism - each is a genuine, well-drafted candidate about a REAL but DIFFERENT provision than the one it is being credited against, and each was independently flagged as non-corresponding by the fresh reviewer for two separate, unrelated GT claims. This is systemic (the same small set of candidates causing multiple distinct false matches), not a long tail of unrelated one-off errors.
risks.whyNotFixedThisPhase: This was discovered via this rerun's own results, AFTER the pre-rerun freeze (08-pre-rerun-freeze.json) and after the code changes were already committed. Per Sections 18/21/29, no further code change is permitted after seeing rerun results, regardless of how well-diagnosed the cause is. This is disclosed here specifically so a future iteration does not have to rediscover it.
possibleGeneralizedRemediationDirections: Require sub-provision structural identity (matching lettered/numbered sub-reference between GT sectionRef and candidate sectionRef, when both are structurally nested under the same parent covenant) as an additional signal the safe-surfacing/partial-credit gate checks before granting 'corresponding' status - not a package-specific rule, since sectionRef parsing (splitSectionRef in source-excerpt.ts) is already fully generic.

Route CORRESPONDS_PARTIALLY pairs (not only INDETERMINATE ones) to the live semantic judge when the missing/silent required dimension is itself one that would be expected to distinguish siblings (e.g., E_ECONOMICS or F_CONDITIONS_EXCEPTIONS silence under a shared covenant family) - this changes Section 17's call-routing policy, which is a real design decision requiring its own validation, not a one-line tweak.
Neither direction is recommended over the other here; a future iteration should treat this as an open design question, not a pre-decided fix.

risks.status: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED - one confirmed pathway fixed, a second distinct pathway confirmed still open
risks.mechanism: The source-excerpt.ts fix (03-definition-overmatch-root-cause.json) corrected the GT-side excerpt-contamination pathway (verified: doc-a::I::commitments-and-facility-sizes's false match against the 'Acquisition' IR-definition candidate is gone). This rerun's independent reviewer found a SECOND, DISTINCT pathway still open: the same 'Acquisition' IR-definition candidate (ir-definition:007a5206dfd349a2dec8b9c0) was ALSO matched (PARTIAL credit) against doc-a::I::permitted-supply-chain-financing, an entirely unrelated defined term, via the candidate's own generic definitional lexical overlap (not a GT-side excerpt contamination) clearing the correspondence bar.
risks.relationToR3: This may be the SAME underlying class of defect as R3 (weak lexical/family-level correspondence sufficing for a DEFINITION-type claim with no distinguishing action signal) rather than a fully separate mechanism - not conclusively distinguished within this phase's effort budget.

risks.status: OBSERVED, NOT RESOLVED - genuinely ambiguous between three explanations
risks.observation: Across all 42 comparable cases in this rerun, the independent second-pass reviewer used ONLY 3 of the 10 available disposition labels (UNSUPPORTED_SILENT, DISCOVERY_ONLY_NOT_REPRESENTED, GT_NOT_RESOLVABLE) - never VERIFIED_OR_UNVERIFIED_REPRESENTATION, PARTIAL_REPRESENTATION, HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED, REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG_ONLY, CONTRADICTORY, or AMBIGUOUS. This produced a 100% safe-surfacing false-positive rate (12-safe-surfacing-calibration.json) and a 0/4 agreement on every case V2 credited.
threeOpenExplanations: EVALUATOR_DEFECT: V2's safe-surfacing and partial/full-credit gates remain genuinely too permissive (R3/R4 above support this reading for at least 6 of the 42 cases with concrete, traceable mechanisms).

REVIEWER_SEVERITY_MISCALIBRATION: an independent LLM-based reviewer applying the 'Ctrl-F test' worked example strictly may systematically under-use the safe-surfacing/partial-credit labels relative to how a human domain expert would apply the same rubric - the complete absence of ANY use of 6 of 10 available labels across 42 varied cases is itself an unusual distribution worth treating with suspicion, not just accepting at face value.

SAMPLE_COMPOSITION: the frozen 51-case sample was drawn (Phase 3F.1.5) to be materiality-stratified and may be genuinely dominated by DSGR content this pipeline compiled poorly in its first-blind run (documented in earlier phases as producing 'almost no substantive representations') - a low true-positive rate in the underlying data would also produce this pattern independent of any evaluator or reviewer defect.
risks.whyNotResolvedThisPhase: Distinguishing between these three explanations would require either a second, differently-instructed independent reviewer pass (to test for reviewer-specific severity), a fresh domain-expert audit of a subsample against the raw source documents (to test SAMPLE_COMPOSITION), or further evaluator-side tracing of the other 36 comparable cases beyond the 6 concretely diagnosed in R3/R4 (to test EVALUATOR_DEFECT more completely) - all of which are themselves new investigative work, not corrections to the code already implemented, and therefore out of scope for a single bounded phase per Section 29's 'stop and diagnose, do not patch again' instruction.

risks.status: DISCLOSED, MECHANISM CONFIRMED, NOT INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED AGAINST GROUND TRUTH
risks.reference: 13-cross-dataset-regression.json's observedDispositionShifts section. Two FWRG units and part of LSB's confusion-matrix distribution shifted as a direct, generic consequence of the SOLE_DIMENSION_OBJECT_THRESHOLD fix. Neither package's own ground-truth adjudication notes were re-reviewed to confirm which direction (before or after) was actually correct - out of scope (no ground-truth mutation or re-adjudication of FWRG/LSB/CONMED was authorized this phase).

risksExplicitlyNotIntroducedByThisPhase.note: For completeness: this phase did not touch, and therefore carries no NEW risk regarding, production discovery/compiler/verifier/IR/precedent/amendment logic, ground truth content, package-specific or term-specific branches (grep-confirmed zero in 15-diff-classification.json), or the frozen sample/protocol/thresholds/historical artifacts (hash-confirmed unchanged in 08-pre-rerun-freeze.json).
